notes: You can now type anime names with spaces. "sousou no frieren" works just like sousou_no_frieren. Words are only joined when they form a real Sakugabooru tag, so normal multi-tag searches, order:score, rating:s and -tag keep working exactly as before.
The autocomplete understands spaces too: while you type "sousou no fri" it suggests sousou_no_frieren, and picking it replaces the words you typed.
When a search finds nothing, a "Did you mean" row suggests similar tags (a typo like "friren" suggests frieren). It only asks Sakugabooru, the same service the search already uses.
SHA256 and ZIP checks, size limits, one update at a time, automatic backup and rollback.
